### Outdoor Holding Company Announces Preferred Stock Dividend


November 12, 2026


**Dallas, Texas, Nov. 12, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) --** Outdoor Holding Company (Nasdaq: POWW, POWWP) (“OHC,” “we,” “us,” “our” or the “Company”), the owner of[GunBroker.com](http://gunbroker.com/) , the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products, today announced that the holders of record of the Company’s 8.75% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock (the “Series A Preferred Stock”) as of the close of business on December 1, 2026 will receive a cash dividend equal to $0.546875 per share of Series A Preferred Stock. The cash dividend will be paid on December 15, 2026.


**About Outdoor Holding Company**


Outdoor Holding Company is the publicly traded parent and operator of GunBroker.com, the largest online marketplace dedicated to firearms, hunting, shooting and related products. Third-party sellers list items on the site and federal and state laws govern the sale of firearms and other restricted items. Firearms sold through the marketplace are transferred through federally licensed firearms dealers in accordance with applicable law. Launched in 1999, the[GunBroker.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=9ttIYttqGwxhleLFFI39LEu4nEBfcsVzS4MQOc5sJ-RF0y0WdAvNV7IZEdhfXnzYt0ks5NChIx_HNqEOUJ5KHQ==) website is an informative, secure and safe way to buy and sell firearms, ammunition, shooting accessories and outdoor gear online. GunBroker promotes responsible ownership of guns and firearms. For more information, visit:[www.gunbroker.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=LKiNhr-6S2fN2AH9VWJOB7VU3AKjn-NCtf_XmOdFiSLsQRlaFgXomUw-1HV3EWdSD4EqnqFFa5aHaEuBM_eRNYH0HH8T-rcBaJNET3jizjI=) .
